note: The product's recorded Core Web Vitals, per route, per emulated device, per cache temperature, plus the four product timings the 2026-09-05 audit's R2 named. perf/route-budgets.json holds what a route COSTS; this holds what a person FEELS. Read docs/perf/baseline-2026-09-05.md before changing a number: down is free, and up needs a sentence in `debt` saying what got slower and why. lib/webVitalsBaseline.ts owns the rules; e2e/cwv-baseline.spec.ts is the only writer, under `npm run perf:cwv-record`, and the same spec under `npm run perf:cwv-sweep` is the fence, spent by hand before a merge because no CI job runs it. A figure over its R2 target (LCP 2500 ms, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1) is DEBT and must carry its reason: __tests__/webVitalsBaseline.test.ts fails on an unowned one.

method.build: local production build (NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-prod), keyless, served by next start; Playwright Chromium with SwiftShader so the map gets a real WebGL2 context and the sweep measures the map rather than its fallback. Taken on a shared box at load average ~52 on 18 cores, so these are pessimistic ceilings rather than clean figures.
method.inpNote: INP is the worst interaction the run produced, read off Event Timing entries carrying an interactionId. The API's durationThreshold floors at 16 ms, so a route whose interaction finished inside one frame reports no entry and is recorded at 16 rather than at 0: we did not see it, which is not the same as it taking no time.
method.coverage: Mobile only, 3 runs per cell, median, from ONE sweep of the shipped tree (docs/proof/perf-baseline-fix/sweep-after-arm.log). Desktop is NOT recorded: the desktop /map cell has never completed a run on this harness, and a bounded re-measurement on 5 Sep was taken at load average 70 and produced no painted pin in two of three mobile samples, so it is reported in the doc and deliberately not used as a ceiling. plan-acknowledged-save is absent because its run timed out on a dropped tap before the retry idiom landed. Every figure here was printed by a run; none was typed.

routes.debt: The map streams its venue shards and the UK base layer after paint on a throttled phone; docs/perf/baseline-2026-09-05.md names the remaining gate. Measured on a shared box at load average ~52; the interaction is real but the figure carries that contention. Recorded so it cannot regress unnoticed.
